text_block_list.text: <chrname> seems to have suffered a minor injury…

However, we are in the middle of the 
precious Summer Camp. Now, what should I 
do—
choice_data_list: Make sure she takes a break

text_block_list.text:
I decided to make sure that she would 
focus on her treatment.

<chrname> couldn't move her body and felt a little 
down…

I decided to give <chrname> some encouragement and 
tried to continue on—

But it failed! The injury seems to have 
gotten worse…

Then, miraculously, her injury healed 
completely, and practice went well!
